title: Recursive Function Class
html:
[Hypothesis]

  • \(k \in \mathbb{N}\) (元数)
  • \(f:\mathbb N^k\rightharpoonup\mathbb N\) (partial function)
  • \(\mathrm{PartRec}(f),\mathrm{Rec}(f)\) (partial/total recursive predicates, see 90-df-recursive-function)
  • \(\mathrm{PartRec}_k,\mathrm{Rec}_k\) (function classes, defined here)
  • \(\mathrm{RecPred}_k\) (recursive-predicate class, defined here)

[Assertion]

[Remark]

  • \(\mathrm{Rec}_k\)：\(k\) 元递归函数集合
  • \(\mathrm{RecPred}_k\)：\(k\) 元递归谓词集合（特征函数属于 \(\mathrm{Rec}_k\)）
  • 见 90-df-recursive-function
